meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Crucible Breach Drill
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist Chief Overseer Valen during a simulated containment breach to ensure the kilns remain stable.
improvisation_points: Consult Valen-Alpha on the simulation parameters.
Obtain specialized coolant from Technician Lira-Alpha.
Override the false lockout initiated by Sentinel-Alpha.

quests.title: Sensor Network Overhaul
quests.narrative_guidance: Repair the sensor networks in the deep core during a sudden emergency radiation alert.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted repair sequence from Lira-Prime.
Secure the perimeter against over-active drones led by Sigma-Prime.
Upload the new calibration data to Analyst Jex-Prime.

quests.title: Void Vault Security
quests.narrative_guidance: Bypass the AI Sentinel's false warnings to access restricted vaults in the scrap yard.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the override code from Sentinel-Null's mainframe.
Obtain the physical vault key from Envoy Rho-Null.
Submit the final access log to Valen-Null for verification.

quests.title: Drone Malfunction Sweep
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate why the Security Drone Cluster is misidentifying personnel in the foundries.
improvisation_points: Interview Sigma-Alpha regarding recent targeting errors.
Cross-reference the sensor data with Analyst Jex-Alpha.
Deploy Droid-Alpha to reset the malfunctioning cluster.

quests.title: The High-Risk Convoy
quests.narrative_guidance: Coordinate with the Cartel Envoy to secure a high-risk isotope shipment destined for the Hegemon.
improvisation_points: Receive the manifest and vault keys from Rho-Prime.
Get safety clearance from Valen-Prime at the Lead Archives.
Synchronize the delivery timing with Sentinel-Prime's logic array.

quests.title: Anomalous Signature Hunt
quests.narrative_guidance: Analyze anomalous radiation patterns in the dormitories to prevent a major leak.
improvisation_points: Decrypt the cryptic log symbols provided by Jex-Null.
Escort Droid-Null through the high-rad zones to seal cracks.
Confirm the containment with Technician Lira-Null.

quests.title: Critical System Response
quests.narrative_guidance: Respond to a sudden system failure across multiple sectors to prevent a total meltdown.
improvisation_points: Receive the emergency beacon from Droid-Alpha.
Divert power from the Barter-Ducts with help from Sigma-Null.
Use Rho-Alpha's master keys to reboot the Enrichment Spires.

quests.title: The Simulated Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist in a high-stakes containment drill to test the facility's reaction time.
improvisation_points: Obtain the simulation schedule from Tech Lyra-9.
Calibrate the patrol path for Drone Cluster Alpha.
Confirm successful containment with Tech Silla.

quests.title: The Isotope Relay
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure a shipment of heavy rods reaches Leadspire Prime without being flagged by the AI.
improvisation_points: Collect the shipment manifest from Envoy Drax.
Verify the radiation signatures with Analyst Teneb.
Deliver the secure vault keys to Envoy Jax.

quests.title: Sensor Net Patch
quests.narrative_guidance: Repair the flickering sensor array before the Archon notices the data gap.
improvisation_points: Receive the error coordinates from Analyst Mir.
Bypass the lockdown initiated by Sentinel Unit X-1.
Log the repair completion with Droid Beta-4.

quests.title: Bio-Sleeve Purge
quests.narrative_guidance: Clear the organic filters of radioactive buildup to maintain shield integrity.
improvisation_points: Get the purge authorization from Overseer Thorne.
Manually cycle the valves with Tech Miri.
Secure the seals under the gaze of Sentinel Unit Z-3.

quests.title: Lead Quarry Log
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover lost data logs from the quarry floor during a drone malfunction.
improvisation_points: Receive the retrieval orders from Envoy Quinn.
Decode the encrypted site symbols with Analyst Vorn.
Vent the pressure at the extraction point via Droid Delta-9.

quests.title: Vapor Lock Crisis
quests.narrative_guidance: A sudden pressure spike threatens the vapor locks; immediate manual intervention is required.
improvisation_points: Respond to the alarm triggered by Droid Gamma-7.
Redirect the power flow through the Flux-Bridges via Drone Cluster Gamma.
Submit the incident report to Overseer Vahn.

quests.title: Cross-City Sync
quests.narrative_guidance: Coordinate the timing of the Gantry rotation with the Quarry extraction cycles.
improvisation_points: Receive the rotation timing from Overseer Kaelen.
Align the transfer schedules with Envoy Drax.
Update the containment maps with Analyst Vorn.

quests.title: The Criticality Simulation
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist Chief Overseer Vass during a high-stakes containment drill designed to test the staff's reaction speed.
improvisation_points: Consult Overseer Vass for the simulation parameters.
Calibrate the sifting sensors with Sifter-Unit 71.
Submit the results to Guardian Node Sigma-1 for evaluation.

quests.title: Broken Grid Relay
quests.narrative_guidance: The energy grid is fluctuating. Repair the sensor networks to prevent a cascading power failure.
improvisation_points: Obtain the repair codes from Technician Mira.
Trace the power leak through the arteries with Analyst Zephyr.
Authorize the repair materials with Broker Kael Rho.

quests.title: Ghost Alarms
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate a series of false alarms that are causing the security drones to panic.
improvisation_points: Silence the local alarm triggers at Pylon Swarm Alpha.
Verify the gate logs with Gatekeeper Valen-S.
Upload the sensor patches to Bulwark-Sentinel B1.

quests.title: Archive Smuggling
quests.narrative_guidance: A shipment of restricted isotopes needs to be moved without alerting the AI oversight.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted manifest from Archive Envoy Rho-X.
Hide the isotope signatures with Analyst Fray's assistance.
Log the package as 'Vitrified Waste' with Silo-Chief Valen-Z.

quests.title: Basin Contamination
quests.narrative_guidance: Heavy water levels are rising. You must prevent a breach in the Sub-Containment Vault.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the drainage sequence from Hydrology Tech Lira-C.
Escort the Vault-Breach Droid to the primary leak site.
Override the emergency lockout with Casket AI.

quests.title: External Signal Leak
quests.narrative_guidance: Unknown signals are bleeding through the shielding. Track and neutralize the source.
improvisation_points: Isolate the frequency with Analyst Jex-B.
Secure the clearance for the exterior zones from Envoy Drax.
Deploy the automated rescue beacons with Rescue Unit Echo.

quests.title: Plasma Flush Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: The enrichment spires are overheating. A manual flush of the plasma arteries is required.
improvisation_points: Initiate the countdown with Droid Unit-Red.
Clear the maintenance shafts using Patrol Swarm 09's sensors.
Stabilize the output flow with Analyst Zephyr.
